sys: System root path based on the operating system
mdir: Directory to move raw input images after extracting information and assigning new PIDs.
wandbpro: Weights & Biases project name for logging
desired_spacings: Target voxel spacing for image resampling
train_val_ds: List of clinics or data sources included in training/validation
test_ds: List of clinics or data sources reserved for testing
split: Choose training strategy in terms of splitting.
test_patients: List of patient IDs reserved for testing
master_df: Filename of the master dataframe CSV
alien_test_path: Path to external test patient list
g_target_idx: Indices of target landmarks to detect
g_alpha: Alpha parameter controlling Gaussian heatmap spread
resume: Resume training from a saved checkpoint
resume_dir: Directory to resume training checkpoint from
num_workers: Number of worker threads for data loading
num_fts: Number of feature channels for backbone network
reduction: Method to reduce loss values (e.g., mean, sum)
loss: Loss functions to be applied (accepts list)
radius_num: Number of radius values to evaluate
detector: Method used for landmark extraction from heatmaps
